human_annotation_independence.finding: Zero genuine human annotators participated. Human 1 was generated via in-memory dictionary clone of heuristic eval_record (dict(eval_record)). Human 2 was cloned with two hardcoded manual index swaps (indices 45 and 120).

automated_evaluator_implementation.finding: No LLM API calls were executed. gpt-4o-2024-08-06 was not called. Scoring was executed via Python keyword string heuristics ('cap' in raw_text.lower()).

cross_evaluator_independence.finding: Claude 3.5 Sonnet was not called via API. Cross-evaluator record was created via in-memory dictionary clone of eval_record (dict(eval_record)).

agreement_statistics_validity.finding: Reported perfect agreement (ICC = 1.0000) was a mathematical artifact of comparing in-memory dictionary clones to each other (x == x). Cohen's kappa of 0.9849 on M5 was synthetically manufactured by hardcoding 2 label discrepancies in Human 2.

gpt4o_target_overlap_claim.finding: Reported delta ICC of 0.0000 was trivial because eval_record == h1_record for all models. No empirical test of self-preference bias was performed.
